subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four deterministic assertion repairs, should OpenClaw accept these exact credentialed and security-sensitive action revisions together?
rationale: The repository can mechanically prove pin consistency, but approving changed third-party execution paths for secrets and write-capable permissions requires owner intent.

options.title: Accept after focused review
options.body: Verify effective permission and credential handling, repair all assertions, and merge only after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Split sensitive revisions
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, container-publishing, and code-scanning action bumps for narrower review and rollback.

options.title: Retain current pins
options.body: Pause the grouped update while Dependabot access and owner review remain unstable.

recommendation.title: Accept after focused review
recommendation.body: Verify effective permission and credential handling, repair all assertions, and merge only after exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This code owner governs the dependency-guard security boundary and exact-pin enforcement most directly implicated by the PR.
